cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem předmětu je studentům představit praktické aspekty účetnictví, daní a auditu při řešení z praxe vycházejících případových studií. Řešení těchto studií bude pod vedením odborníků z praxe, kdy pozornost bude věnována zpracování účetní závěrky včetně sestavení daňového přiznání, daňové kontrole a praktickým aspektům plánování a provádění statutárního auditu. Výuka je zajišťována externisty z poradenské společnosti BDO Czech Republic.

cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: Zápočet je udělen za aktivní účast na seminářích. Výuka bude koncipována jako 4 hodinové setkání 1x za 14 dní. Pro udělení zápočtu je nutné navštívit alespoň 4 ze 6 setkání, vypracovat úkoly zadané vyučujícím a splnit písemný test, který bude obsahovat 10 testových otázek (min úspěšnost 6 bodů).

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to introduce students to the practical aspects of accounting, taxes, and auditing through case studies based on real-world scenarios. These case studies will be solved under the guidance of experts, with a focus on preparing financial statements, including filing tax returns, tax audits, and the practical aspects of planning and conducting statutory audits. The course is taught by external experts from the consulting firm BDO Czech Republic.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Accounting for Business Corporations in Practice (allowance 0/4) a.Accounting for general business transactionsb.Impairments of receivablesc.Calculation of asset depreciation and its evidenced.Specific accounting cases – deferred tax, financial assets2.Preparation of Financial Statements, Compilation of Financial Reports, and Notes to Financial Statements (allowance 0/4) a.The process of stocktakingb.Recording of closing entries – foreign currency revaluation, VAT settlementc.Preparation of materials for the corporate income tax returnd.Preparation of the Balance Sheet and Income Statement3.Preparation of Corporate Income Tax Return (allowance 0/4) a.Transformation of accounting economic result to taxable incomeb.Items that affect the tax basec.Tax-deductible and non-deductible expenses/costsd.Impact of different accounting and tax depreciation methods on taxable income4.Tax Audit, Case Study, Preparation of Individual Income Tax Return (allowance 0/4) a.Practical example of the tax audit processb.Types of interactions between the tax authority and the taxpayerc.Various types of individual's income and their tax regimesd.Taxation of income from crypto currencies5.Audit Process from a Practical Perspective - Planning (allowance 0/4) a.Assessing the feasibility of accepting the audit engagementb.Determining materialityc.Selection of areas for audit verificationd.Reconciling accounting data and verifying its validity6.Audit Process from a Practical Perspective - Execution (allowance 0/4) a.Audit of revenue items – cut-off testb.Personal expenses audit – recalculation of wages/salaries, verification of balancesc.Cash audit – evaluation of balances, recalculations, and reportingd.Audit of receivables and payables – selection of business partners, sending and evaluating confirmation letterse.Verification of financial statements

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: The credit is awarded for active participation in seminars. The classes will be organized as 4-hour sessions held once every two weeks. To receive the credit, it is necessary to attend at least 4 out of 6 sessions, complete the assignments given by the lector, and pass a written test consisting of 10 multiple-choice questions (with a minimum requirement of 6 correct answers).
